start_precondition: Parent relays native application generation/oracle jobs idle; no other deliberate timing job. Paced core soak and external host load remain disclosed.
profile: default system heap, K32, native runtime O2 and generated LLVM O2; no counter instrumentation or sanitizers
scope: Repeated aggregate joins using lexer-fragment-like immutable inputs, not full compiler execution or isolated public-function latency. Fragment construction precedes the repeated loop; no compiler arena timing claim.
modes: known ASCII result4096 bytes, querying each result length
known short ASCII result15 bytes, querying each result length
persistent unknown ASCII result4096 bytes, querying each result length
Unicode mixed accent/nonBMP result4096 UTF8 bytes, querying each result length
known ASCII result4096 bytes without character queries; byteLength checksum instead
pilot: One bounded baseline run per mode chooses identical before/after loop counts targeting0.15–0.30 CPU seconds, bounded1000000 loops; no discarded pilot row and no pilot performance inference. Final loop count is frozen before pairs.

paired_design.order: Seeded random mode order in each block and random AB/BA order within each mode pair. Preserve all rows, even noisy pairs.
paired_design.warmups: One baseline and one candidate execution per mode, recorded separately before pairs.
paired_design.metrics: Child user+system CPU deltas and wall seconds separately; exact stdout checksum and return code required. Immutable compiler/runtime/source/binary hashes retained before and after.
paired_design.intervals: 95% paired-block bootstrap interval of geometric mean baseline/candidate CPU ratio,10000 resamples; mode-specific wall results reported separately. No exclusion by ratio or wall time.
paired_design.contamination: Record system environment and active paced cohort status; shared host can vary schedules, cache state and CPU speed. No quiet-host claim or hard wall-latency interpretation.

decision_thresholds.positive: Known-large CPU ratio baseline/candidate must exceed1.03, with95% lower bound>1, before timing supports adoption.
decision_thresholds.negative_no_query: Reject if candidate/baseline has95% lower bound>1.03.
decision_thresholds.negative_short_unknown_unicode: Reject if candidate/baseline has95% lower bound>1.05 in any control.
decision_thresholds.unresolved: If intervals cannot resolve the criteria, retain the count-based candidate as test-only; do not interpret failure to reject as proof of no slowdown.

resources: Serial builds/executions; no concurrent own tests. Per-child timeout30s, CPU60s, output256MiB, memory768MiB wrapper; logical live payload bounded32MiB with asserted input/output sizes. No retained per-operation journal.
source_freeze: No production runtime or active soak source changes. Both sustained source-frozen cohorts complete before any adoption decision.
